title: add new container-libs vendor check
body:
With the container-libs repos we either only supported the tagged versions or using the same vendor commit for all of the at the same time. Mixing different commits, while possible, can run into untested version combinations that cause weird errors later on.

To avoid the mismatch add a custom bash script to validate that either all modules use a proper tag or all modules use the same commit.

LGTM as such. Is this renovate-proof?

> LGTM as such. Is this renovate-proof?

it should be, the renovate config should make it update all modules at once, e.g.
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29215

There is a caveat that renovate currently fails to correctly handle our post container-libs release merge back into main process to fix the go tooling in which case renovate fails to lookup the module versions for commits prior to that merge. In that case a manual bump of all modules past the merge point is needed. But this has nothing to do with the check added here.
